Deployment Capability

The Problem We Solve

Why complex projects fail
in difficult environments.

Most project failures in complex markets are not operational — they are cultural and institutional. International organisations consistently underestimate the gap between how they work and how things actually get done on the ground — whether that's because formal systems are absent, unpredictably enforced, or simply built on entirely different foundations.

The Plan
International Organisation

Formal legal & institutional frameworks assumed to be present and functional

Methodology & structures designed for advanced economy contexts

Strategic decisions made from HQ, distanced from operational reality

Relationships managed through formal procurement & contracting

THE GAP
Cultural & institutional misalignment at strategic, delivery & human levels
Project failure
Wasted resource
Reputational damage
The Reality
Complex Market Environment

Frameworks that are absent, unpredictably enforced — or fully functional but built on entirely different foundations

Clan, tribe, religion & personal relationships govern access — not contracts

Ground truth only accessible through embedded, culturally fluent presence

Trust built through shared experience & context — not formal process

RBM Global bridges this gap — deploying hybrid cultural advisors and experienced teams who understand both sides, embedded at the point where failure occurs.

This framework is grounded in academic research and validated through interviews with senior decision-makers across defence, professional services, enterprise technology and legal sectors. It forms the intellectual foundation of RBM Global's approach — and the subject of our founder's MSc dissertation, awarded with distinction by the University of Bath.

What We Do

Five capabilities.
One integrated approach.

We combine talent and technology to deliver Capability as a Service — structured around the specific demands of your challenge, not a generic consulting framework.

Research-backed

Embedded Cultural Advisory

Hybrid cultural advisors embedded directly within your team — individuals who straddle both worlds, providing real-time cultural and institutional intelligence for complex market entry. We cover all legal permits, life support and administration, with zero burden on the client. Validated with senior leaders across defence, professional services and technology sectors.

Complex Programme Delivery

End-to-end programme design, mobilisation and delivery in high-risk, multi-stakeholder environments — including active conflict zones, post-conflict regions and politically sensitive markets.

Market Entry & Feasibility

In-country assessments, stakeholder mapping and strategic analysis for organisations entering complex or contested markets. We protect your brand while you evaluate the opportunity — operating in your stead when required.

Project Rescue & Turnaround

Brought in when programmes are failing — overdue, over budget, or fractured. We rapidly diagnose, re-structure and catalyse delivery, repairing stakeholder relationships and navigating complex IP and logistical constraints in the process.

Capability Building & Technology

Designing and delivering strategic capability uplift across government, security and commercial organisations — from technology transformation and multi-agency operations centres to security sector reform.

About RBM Global

Built from experience
others don't have.

RBM Global was founded by Rob McPherson — who grew up across Zimbabwe's mining regions, living on both sides of the tribal border between Matabeleland and Mashonaland before the country's economic collapse forced a move to the UK. That immersion from an early age gave Rob a visceral, formative understanding of how culture shapes everything: who trusts whom, who moves where, and why transplanted systems so often fail.

Entering the British military as an enlisted Royal Marine, Rob was selected for an Officer's Commission from the ranks — a highly competitive distinction. As a Royal Marine Officer, he deployed across Afghanistan and led host-nation capability development across North Africa, the Sahel and beyond — including attachments to specialist counter-terrorism and advisory units operating in some of the world's most challenging environments. Every failure he observed traced back to the same root cause: cultural and institutional misalignment.

Nearly two decades of independent consulting across 26 countries on-site followed — delivering programmes ranging from strategic risk management during active conflicts, to security sector reform engaging stakeholders from Heads of State to local clan representatives, to the digital transformation of a global market intelligence firm ahead of its acquisition.

RBM Global brings all of that together — and Rob's MSc research at the University of Bath, awarded with distinction, provides the academic framework that codifies what he spent 20 years learning in the field.

MSc Entrepreneurship, Management & Innovation

University of Bath — dissertation: Embedded cultural consulting services for complex market entry. Also: Entrepreneurial Edge (London Business School) · Managing Technological Innovation (Open University).

Dissertation awarded with Distinction

Scale of Delivery

26 countries on-site · 8 remotely managed · Stakeholders from Heads of State and multinational CEOs to local clan representatives · Programmes with direct impact across 10,000+ individuals and institutions.

How We Work

Five principles.
Built for complexity.

Every engagement is different. These are the principles that remain constant.

01

Rapid Deployment

We mobilise expert teams at short notice — in some cases within 72 hours — into environments others are not prepared or equipped to enter.

02

Absolute Discretion

Many of our clients require us to operate in their stead. We protect their identity, brand and commercial interests throughout every engagement.

03

Cultural Fluency

We don't impose international frameworks. We understand the cultural and institutional landscape of the target environment and work within it.

04

Integrated Capability

We combine the right talent with the right technology — assembling bespoke teams around each challenge rather than applying a fixed methodology.

05

End-to-End Ownership

From concept to delivery, we take full accountability — including budget authority, stakeholder management and operational execution.
